value.rationale: A natural unresolved temporal-ergodicity question for a physically motivated confined historical resetting mechanism. The explicit r=κ transition distinguishes conventional T^{-1} self-averaging from logarithmic and anomalously slow power-law variance decay even though every one-time Gibbs marginal is exactly unchanged, clarifying what equilibrium one-time measurements cannot reveal.
